# Pi 1.0.0 `pi-logo-animation.ts`

`pi-logo-animation.ts` is `packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/components/pi-logo-animation.ts` of Pi 1.0.0 (tag `v1.0.0`), copied byte for byte (MIT, Copyright (c) 2025 Mario Zechner). Pi 1.0.1 replaced it with the generalized `easter-egg-3d.ts`. PiG's logo animation (D87) is a port of this file, so `pig-logo-animation-oracle.mjs` runs it as the oracle for `TestPigLogoAnimationMatchesPinnedPi` while the pinned mirror no longer contains it.
